column1: # Category assignment for Oniomarchy's Security Tools menu.
# category_id matches the security.<id> submenu ids defined in menu.sh.
#   auto     - discover real binaries via pacman -Ql at run time. 1 binary
#              -> single entry, 2+ -> subcategory listing every binary.
#              Any binary that matches a real installed .desktop Exec
#              target still gets its own entry here (the Security menu is
#              a complete category view, not deduped against Apps — user
#              call, 2026-08-25) but launches directly instead of through
#              a terminal wrapper, since it's already a GUI app.
#   skip     - package isn't installed yet, or is a broken/excluded
#              entry generated (no guessing at binaries for something
#   collapse - force a single entry running just `extra`, ignoring the
#              package's other binaries (used for john/hashcat, whose
#              rows of rarely-used format converters — see
#              notes/install-layout.md decision log for this and the
#   data     - non-executable data package; single entry opens `extra`
#              (a real directory, confirmed via pacman -Ql) in the file
